summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan for the Web Messenger Ultimate Upgrade:
1. Loud, customizable audio engine with dedicated ringtones, message chimes, volume slider, and background incoming call alerts.
2. High-capacity chunked & resumable video uploader with speed/ETA indicators, large file streaming, and multi-file composer attachment staging with captions.
3. Universal Friend ID normalizer supporting #WM-xxxx and WM-xxxx, direct share links, and safe copy.
4. Two-step registration flow (Email/Password -> First/Last Name, Age, Country, Profile Photo from camera/gallery/avatars).
5. Group creation with custom photo upload from local gallery/computer with live preview.
6. Redesigned white search bar with quick filters (All, People, Groups, Photos, Videos, Documents) and recent searches.
